source_caption_text:
#OhGeesy Brings Out His Mom During “Bands” At SOLD OUT Seattle Show With Shoreline Mafia (18,000+ People) While On Tour With The $u***deboy$ 🥹❤️

“I’m Finna Get This Money, Give It Right To My Momma” 💯

OhGeesy, whose real name is Alejandro Carranza, is a Los Angeles rapper best known as one of the founding members and faces of Shoreline Mafia. He began making music with Fenix Flexin after the two met through Los Angeles’ graffiti scene. The group broke through independently with ShoreLineDoThatShit in 2017, producing fan favorites such as “Musty,” “Nun Major,” “Bottle Service” and “Bands.” Their momentum eventually led to a deal with Atlantic Records in 2018, helping turn Shoreline Mafia from a buzzing L.A. act into a nationally recognized West Coast rap group. 

OhGeesy became especially recognizable for his laid-back delivery, catchy hooks and distinctly West Coast sound. Shoreline Mafia continued building its audience with projects including Party Pack, Party Pack Vol. 2 and Mafia Bidness, with the latter reaching No. 27 on the Billboard 200. Over the years, OhGeesy has worked with major artists including Future, YG, Kodak Black, Tyga, Lil Yachty, DaBaby, A Boogie wit da Hoodie, Central Cee and 03 Greedo, among others. 

When Shoreline Mafia went on hiatus around 2020, OhGeesy successfully established himself as a solo artist. His debut solo project, GEEZYWORLD, arrived in 2021 and included collaborations with YG, DaBaby, A Boogie wit da Hoodie, Central Cee and others. He followed it with GEEZYWORLD 2 in 2023 and continued releasing music, including Paid N Full in 2025. His solo career allowed him to keep the sound that made him popular with Shoreline while building his own identity and catalog. 

One of the biggest developments in his career came when OhGeesy and Fenix Flexin reunited as Shoreline Mafia. They returned with “HEAT STICK” in 2024, which became Shoreline Mafia’s first song to enter the Billboard Hot 100. The reunion continued with Back In Bidness in 2025 and BIDNESS IS BOOMIN in 2026, giving a new generation of listeners a chance to experience the group while longtime fans got to see OhGeesy & Fenix together again.
